exposure: Number of pulls during vacuum-assisted delivery
Number of pulls during vacuum-assisted delivery (1, 2, 3, and ≥4 pulls)
number of pulls during vacuum-assisted delivery
outcome: Maternal composite outcome (severe perineal laceration, cervical laceration, transfusion, and postpartum hemorrhage ≥500 mL)
cohort: Pregnancies who underwent vacuum-assisted delivery from 2013 to 2020 at a single center
finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery with four or more pulls was significantly associated with an increased risk of NICU admission.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery with four or more pulls was significantly associated with an increased risk of NICU admission, but not with maternal complications.
